description: This file contains functions and definitions for managing power states (light sleep, deep sleep) and peripheral state saving/restoring on a Microchip MEC1501 device within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: soc_lite_sleep_enable
methods.description: Enables light sleep mode by configuring system control register and sleep control.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_enable
methods.description: Enables deep sleep mode by configuring system control register and sleep control.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_disable
methods.description: Disables deep sleep mode and restores system control register.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_wait_clk_idle
methods.description: Waits for clock request signals to become idle, if enabled.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_non_wake_en
methods.description: Configures peripherals to wake the system without waking the entire system.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_periph_save
methods.description: Saves peripheral states before entering deep sleep.

methods.name: soc_deep_sleep_periph_restore
methods.description: Restores peripheral states after waking from deep sleep.
